ambiguity_rule: Do not activate from an unrelated mention of Naya or NayaPOWER. If intent is genuinely ambiguous, ask one concise clarification question rather than guessing.

non_competing_authority: This file is a machine-readable index of the canonical activation contract. It does not define independent activation policy. If this file conflicts with the canonical protocol, the canonical protocol wins.
